title: Clean fit with a 27% private equity holder that said it would consider a fair offer

input.facts: Hematology analyzers with captive reagents: reagents and service are 64% of sales. The share price fell 27% after a one-off charge on a discontinued product line during the switch to its new analyzer generation, which launched on schedule. Nordic Growth Partners IV, a private equity fund, holds 27%; at the May 2026 AGM it said it would 'consider any offer that values the company fairly'. Leverage 2.6x. No regulatory issue.

why: A holder above 25% is a flag only; the thesis rejects only if that holder ruled out a sale. Here the holder is openly receptive. Flag it (name, 27%, statement) and give Priority: everything else fits.
